controls.title: Unique incident identifier assigned
controls.description: Every engagement receives a unique identifier at intake.

controls.title: Legal framework and mandate verified
controls.norm: CPP art. 56 (flagrance) / art. 76 (préliminaire) / art. 94, 97 (commission rogatoire) / art. 60
controls.description: Authorization and legal scope confirmed before any action, per the applicable procedural framework (flagrante / preliminary inquiry / rogatory commission).

controls.title: Order of volatility respected
controls.description: Acquisition planned RAM to network connections to disk, in that order.

controls.title: Forensic Git repository initialized
controls.description: Versioned, timestamped and hashed action log (chain of evidence).

controls.title: Acquisition protocol written
controls.description: Document describing the planned steps for the compromised workstation.

controls.title: Seizure report (PV) completed
controls.description: Signed seizure record per exhibit, consistent with the procedural framework.

controls.title: Chain-of-custody form initiated
controls.description: Who / when / where / how tracking for each piece of evidence.

controls.title: Lessons from similar incidents leveraged
controls.description: Methodological and legal lessons from comparable incidents integrated into the approach.

controls.title: Digital scene documented
controls.description: Power state, devices present and persons on site recorded.

controls.title: Unauthorized access prevented
controls.description: Perimeter isolated and access restricted during the engagement.

controls.title: Official forensic tools identified
controls.description: Validated toolset (Autopsy, FTK Imager, Wireshark, Volatility 3).

controls.title: Investigator responsibilities recalled
controls.description: Neutrality, integrity and professional ethics of the expert.

controls.title: GDPR compliance verified
controls.description: Processing of personal data contained in the evidence is framed.

controls.title: Secure evidence storage prepared
controls.description: Restricted access, physical or logical seals planned.

controls.title: Evidence integrity guaranteed (criminal offence)
controls.description: Destroying, altering, removing or falsifying digital evidence exposes the author to criminal prosecution and engages the responder liability.

controls.title: Evidence and data retention period defined
controls.norm: RGPD art. 5 ; CPP art. 8 (prescription des délits)
controls.description: Retention set per data-minimisation and the applicable prescription (e.g. 6 years for delits); disposal organised at term.

controls.title: Regulatory incident-response obligations identified
controls.norm: Code de la défense art. L.2321-1 et s. ; RGPD art. 33-34 ; Directive (UE) 2022/2555 (NIS2)
controls.description: Check whether the entity is subject to sector obligations for detection, handling and notification (OIV/OSE, banking, telecom operators).

controls.title: Write blocker used
controls.description: Source medium protected read-only before any handling.

controls.title: Bit-for-bit acquisition performed
controls.description: Full forensic image of the medium, E01 or raw format (dd / FTK Imager).

controls.title: SHA-256 hash computed before/after
controls.description: Image integrity verified by comparing fingerprints.

controls.title: Image stored as E01 / DD
controls.description: Standard format usable by Autopsy and FTK Imager.

controls.title: Original sealed, working copy created
controls.description: Distinction between the original medium and the analysis copy.

controls.title: Autopsy analysis performed
controls.description: Timeline, keyword search and browser / USB / registry artefacts explored.

controls.title: Timeline built (Autopsy / Plaso)
controls.description: Super timeline cross-referencing the available timestamps (log2timeline).

controls.title: Deleted files searched
controls.description: Recovery and documentation of erased data.

controls.title: Browser artefacts extracted
controls.description: History, downloads and cookies documented.

controls.title: Windows registry analyzed
controls.description: SAM, SYSTEM, SOFTWARE and NTUSER.DAT hives examined.

controls.title: Persistence and autoruns checked
controls.description: Search for persistent malware and scheduled tasks.

controls.title: 5 significant artefacts documented
controls.description: Minimum expected deliverable for the disk-analysis report.

controls.title: MAC metadata preserved
controls.description: Modified / Accessed / Created timestamps kept intact.

controls.title: Hidden partitions explored
controls.description: Search for disk space not visible by default.

controls.title: Network capture collected (PCAP)
controls.description: Relevant network traffic captured for analysis.

controls.title: PCAP integrity preserved
controls.description: Capture hashed and stored so it cannot be silently altered.

controls.title: Wireshark filters applied
controls.description: Display / capture filters used to isolate the relevant traffic.

controls.title: Follow TCP/HTTP Stream performed
controls.description: Streams reassembled to read the exchanged payloads.

controls.title: Expert Info reviewed
controls.description: Wireshark Expert Info consulted for anomalies.

controls.title: Zeek run on the capture
controls.description: PCAP turned into structured logs (conn/dns/http/ssl).

controls.title: Scan / brute-force patterns identified
controls.description: Reconnaissance and credential-guessing patterns detected.

controls.title: Beaconing / C2 searched
controls.description: Periodic implant-to-C2 communication looked for.

controls.title: Exfiltration searched
controls.description: Large or covert outbound data transfers looked for.

controls.title: Objects extracted from the PCAP
controls.description: Files / objects carved out of the capture.

controls.title: Extracted files verified
controls.description: Carved files hashed and safely inspected (never executed directly).

controls.title: Network IoCs consolidated
controls.description: Network indicators of compromise gathered for the report.

controls.title: Network incident timeline established
controls.description: Chronology of the network events reconstructed.

controls.title: Network recommendations formulated
controls.description: Network hardening / containment recommendations produced.

controls.title: Order of volatility respected
controls.description: Memory prioritised over less-volatile sources.

controls.title: Live memory acquisition performed
controls.description: RAM captured with winpmem (Windows) or LiME (Linux).

controls.title: Memory dump hash computed
controls.description: Dump fingerprinted to prove integrity.

controls.title: Volatility profile / symbol table identified
controls.description: Correct OS profile / symbols selected for analysis.

controls.title: pslist / pstree executed
controls.description: Process list and tree enumerated.

controls.title: netscan executed
controls.description: Network connections and sockets recovered from memory.

controls.title: malfind executed
controls.description: Injected / hidden code regions detected.

controls.title: cmdline executed
controls.description: Process command lines recovered.

controls.title: DLL injection searched
controls.description: Injected DLLs looked for.

controls.title: Rootkits / concealment searched
controls.description: Hidden processes, hooks and rootkit artefacts looked for.

controls.title: Anti-forensic techniques assessed
controls.description: Timestomping, fileless and evasion techniques evaluated.

controls.title: Memory / disk comparison performed
controls.description: Memory findings cross-checked against the disk image.

controls.title: Memory IOCs consolidated
controls.description: Memory indicators of compromise gathered for the report.

controls.title: Memory analysis report written
controls.description: Findings of the memory analysis documented.

controls.title: Multiple sources cross-referenced
controls.description: Disk, memory, network and log sources correlated.

controls.title: Correlated timeline built
controls.description: Single timeline merging all sources.

controls.title: Divergences between sources explained
controls.description: Conflicts between sources reconciled and explained.

controls.title: Incident storytelling written
controls.description: Coherent narrative of the incident produced.

controls.title: Report structure respected
controls.description: Standard report template and structure followed.

controls.title: Methodology documented in the report
controls.description: Methods and tools recorded for reproducibility.

controls.title: Chain of evidence traced in the report
controls.description: Evidence provenance traceable throughout the report.

controls.title: Factual and neutral conclusions
controls.description: Conclusions stay factual, neutral and evidence-backed.

controls.title: Remediation recommendations formulated
controls.description: Actionable remediation recommendations provided.

controls.title: Plain-language summary prepared
controls.description: Non-technical summary prepared for a lay audience.

controls.title: Report reviewed and validated by the team
controls.description: Cross-review before submission.

controls.title: Client debrief material prepared
controls.description: Restitution deck / material prepared for the client.

controls.title: Speaking roles distributed
controls.description: Presentation roles assigned across the team.

controls.title: Final report submitted on time
controls.description: Report delivered within the contractual deadline.

controls.title: Centralized log collection
controls.description: Logs centrally collected across sources.

controls.title: Event correlation configured
controls.description: Correlation rules configured in the SIEM.

controls.title: Anomaly detection enabled
controls.description: Behavioural / anomaly detection active.

controls.title: MITRE ATT&CK mapping performed
controls.description: Observed activity mapped to ATT&CK tactics/techniques.

controls.title: IOC identification
controls.description: Indicators of compromise identified from the logs.

controls.title: Authentication-failure analysis
controls.description: Failed-authentication patterns analysed.

controls.title: Privileged-access audit
controls.description: Privileged access reviewed.

controls.title: Log normalization
controls.description: Logs normalised to a common schema.

controls.title: Consistent timestamps across sources
controls.description: All sources aligned to a single time reference (NTP).

controls.title: Log retention compliant
controls.description: Retention durations meet legal / regulatory requirements.

controls.title: Critical alerts qualified
controls.description: Critical alerts triaged and qualified.

controls.title: SIEM report produced
controls.description: SIEM findings documented in a report.
